summary: Walks a linked list of scrolling/audio entries anchored at this[129] (offset 0x204), advancing via each node's i[4] (+0x10) slot, and for every node updates a batch of offset fields belonging to a specific target object. For a non-NULL target a2 with a3 within its count at a2+164, it computes v3 = *(a2 + 168) + 148 * a3 (a record base) and, when *(v3 + 72) > 1, visits each node whose count i[70] is non-zero, scanning i[71]-anchored 16-byte-strided entries: an entry whose *(v5 - 12) matches a2 gets *v5 incremented by *(v3 + 80) when *v5 is below it (conditional accumulator add).

local_names.a2: target object whose entries are matched and updated (compared against entry owner slot)
local_names.a3: index into the target's record table, bounded by the count at a2+164
local_names.v3: base of the a3-th 148-byte record, derived from *(a2 + 168) + 148 * a3
local_names.i: current linked-list node, advanced via i[4] (+0x10)
local_names.v5: cursor over the node's 16-byte-strided entry array, starts at i[71] + 52
local_names.v6: remaining entry count for the current node, initialized from i[70]

operations.description: If a2 is 0, return without any effect.
If a3 is greater than the count stored at a2+164, return without any effect.
Compute v3 = *(a2 + 168) + 148 * a3, the base address of the a3-th 148-byte record for the target.
If *(v3 + 72) is not greater than 1, return without any effect.
Iterate the node list starting at this[129] (offset 0x204), advancing through each node's i[4] (+0x10) slot until NULL.
If the current node's count i[70] is 0, skip the node.
Inner do-while: scan i[70] entries starting at v5 = i[71] + 52, striding v5 by 16 bytes per entry until the count is exhausted.
If the entry's owner slot at *(v5 - 12) does not equal a2, leave this entry untouched.
For a matching entry: v7 = *v5; v8 = *(v3 + 80); if *v5 < v8 then v7 = v7 + v8 (conditional accumulator add).
Write the updated value back into the entry slot *v5.
Void return after the guarded traversal completes.
Called by sub_448140 (00448140) and AudioDSPStateUpdate (00448330) to scroll/offset linked entry data for a target.
